result.title: Reliability Stress Testing of RAG Retrieval under Query-Relevant Corpus Poisoning
result.summary: External text can affect a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system only after the retriever admits it to the model context. We stress this admission step while varying document content, attacker query information, per-target poison budget, and contamination scope. Across 623 Benchmarking Information Retrieval (BEIR) queries from SciFact and NFCorpus, five query-targeted documents per query reduce classical-retriever nDCG@10 by 40.2-61.5% in isolated-target stress. Full-query anchoring explains most Best Matching 25 (BM25) degradation, whereas appended text also shifts latent semantic analysis (LSA) and Hybrid rankings. A pretrained BGE-small validation reaches 100% target exposure for query-only P=5 on both datasets; adding the injection payload changes SciFact nDCG only from 0.269 to 0.271 and lowers NFCorpus exposure slightly to 98.8%, indicating that query anchoring remains the dominant retrieval-side factor for this dense model. Query length materially changes the interpretation of partial-information attacks: on 162 long SciFact queries, two random terms cover 19.9% of eligible terms and still yield 39.5% Hybrid target exposure. Multi-target contamination adds cross-target interference. Overlap-based admission can remove full-query poisons but may sharply reduce clean retrieval utility, and maximal marginal relevance (MMR) leaves exposure unchanged under the tested configuration. The study measures retrieval-layer failures, not downstream instruction following.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文对 RAG 的检索准入环节做压力测试：在 SciFact 与 NFCorpus 上变化毒化文档内容、攻击者查询信息、毒化预算与污染范围，测量经典与稠密检索器的 nDCG@10 及目标暴露率，并检验基于重叠的过滤与 MMR 的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「哪些外部证据被准入模型上下文」的压力测试与准入过滤协议，或可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据检索与筛选的鲁棒性评估；但研究对象是纯文本检索层，与 latent 状态生成和答案使用无直接联系。
